title: Queue Control Exchange
description: Structural schema companion for contract: durable-queue/v0. One request or response line of the wire binding (line-delimited JSON over stdio or a local socket). The conformance harness drives every implementation through this binding. The op vocabulary is closed; unknown ops fail closed with error code unknown_op. Daemon deployments require token on every request; harness stdio mode may omit it.

id.description: Client correlation id, echoed on the response.

params.description: Op arguments. Shapes are defined per op in the normative standard.

token.description: Invocation key (lock-and-key), as in process-run. Required by daemon deployments.

code.description: unauthorized is the required code for a failed token check and is indistinguishable for wrong versus unknown token.

lease.description: A lease is a value. ack, nack, extend and fail take leases, and the broker checks the fencing token on each.

token.description: Fencing token, opaque, unique per lease. Never written to the ledger.

leaseOutcome.description: stale_lease is an outcome, not an error: it is expected under at-least-once delivery.
